title: Open-source AI models surge with new local tools release #shorts
description: China released a powerful open-source AI model capable of running locally on consumer computers, marking a significant advance in accessible AI technology. Alongside this, a new free tool has emerged that can perfectly clone any website using just a single prompt, showcasing rapid innovation in web automation and AI-assisted content replication. Recent developments include a Watermarks Remover skill that effectively eliminates watermarks from major AI platforms like Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI, addressing challenges in text and image metadata. Meta introduced Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open-source model optimized for single-GPU or Mac use, designed for constant, offline operation without internet or API reliance. XAI launched Grokbot, a Claude-powered AI assistant capable of managing multiple integrated tasks continuously by accessing user accounts and data autonomously. Jipu improved its GLM model to version 5.3, enhancing coding performance by 50%, solidifying its status as the leading open-source AI model for programming. These innovations reflect a broader shift toward decentralized, efficient, and privacy-conscious AI applications, expanding the potential use cases for individuals and businesses without dependence on large-scale cloud infrastructure. #ChinaAI #ClaudeOpus #MetaMuseGlimmer #WatermarksRemover #Grokbot #JipuGLM #OpenSourceAI #AIModel #LocalAI #WebAutomation #AIAssistant #CodingAI #OfflineAI #AIInnovation #AItools
